com.datastax.oss.driver.api.querybuilder.insert

Interface Insert

  • All Superinterfaces:
    BuildableQuery
    All Known Subinterfaces:
    JsonInsert, RegularInsert

    public interface Insert
extends BuildableQuery
    A complete INSERT statement that is ready to be built.

    • Method Detail

      • ifNotExists

        @NonNull
Insert ifNotExists()
        Adds an IF NOT EXISTS clause to this statement.

      • usingTimestamp

        @NonNull
Insert usingTimestamp(long timestamp)
        Adds a USING TIMESTAMP clause to this statement with a literal value.

        If this method or usingTimestamp(BindMarker) is called multiple times, the last value is used.

      • usingTimestamp

        @NonNull
Insert usingTimestamp(@Nullable
                               BindMarker bindMarker)
        Adds a USING TIMESTAMP clause to this statement with a bind marker.

        If this method or usingTimestamp(long) is called multiple times, the last value is used. Passing null to this method removes any previous timestamp.

      • usingTtl

        @NonNull
Insert usingTtl(int ttlInSeconds)
        Adds a USING TTL clause to this statement with a literal value. Setting a value of null will remove the USING TTL clause on this statement. Setting a value of 0 will insert the data with no TTL when the statement is executed, overriding any Table TTL that might exist.

        If this method or usingTtl(BindMarker) is called multiple times, the value from the last invocation is used.

        Parameters:
        ttlInSeconds - Time, in seconds, the inserted data should live before expiring.

      • usingTtl

        @NonNull
Insert usingTtl(@Nullable
                         BindMarker bindMarker)
        Adds a USING TTL clause to this statement with a bind marker. Setting a value of null will remove the USING TTL clause on this statement. Binding a value of 0 will insert the data with no TTL when the statement is executed, overriding any Table TTL that might exist.

        If this method or usingTtl(int) is called multiple times, the value from the last invocation is used.

        Parameters:
        bindMarker - A bind marker that is understood to be a value in seconds.
